maddeler.e:
أنقرئ (form VII)
# أَنْقَرِئُ (ʔanqariʔu) /ʔan.qa.ri.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# أَنْقَرِئَ (ʔanqariʔa) /ʔan.qa.ri.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
# أَنْقَرِئْ (ʔanqariʔ) /ʔan.qa.riʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَرَأَ (inqaraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
